title: A surface between eight samples
description: Eight corner samples become crossings and lookup triangles; margin moves the sheet while classification stays fixed.
limitation: One cell, using the source extractor; no claim that this one demonstration resolves ambiguous marching-cubes cases.

title: A walk taken out of a block
description: Follow the eleven original seeded cutter centres, their union, and the subtraction from a sectioned block.
limitation: A cutter union is not clipped to the stock; cutter connectivity does not establish body clearance.

title: One body, several neighbours
description: Freeze one body, inspect its neighbourhood and three steering contributions, then run the original updater on a private flock.
limitation: A bounded eight-body teaching fixture; original sequential update order retained. No biological or political inference.

title: One learning step
description: Sample the original loss function, expose its finite-difference gradient and learning rate, then follow source-computed steps.
limitation: A toy optimization surface, not a demonstration of neural-network learning or consciousness.

title: The graph keeps its connections
description: A source-generated tree spreads under repulsion and spring forces while its adjacency stays fixed.
limitation: A layout algorithm changes coordinates, not the meaning or validity of the graph.

title: A triangle depends on its surface
description: Source-generated straight and great-circle edges reveal different tangent angles on plane and sphere.
limitation: Separate geometric models; no continuous curvature interpolation, independent area theorem test, or Godel proof.

title: Same draws, a moving threshold
description: Lift fixed source-generated random draws into height, sweep the threshold, and distinguish sample count from binary source entropy.
limitation: Private 64-draw sample; H(p) is source entropy, not thermodynamic entropy or proof of QFEP.

title: No named root, unequal connections
description: Replay source growth with one or three earlier neighbours, then remove a high-degree node and its edges.
limitation: A source graph comparison, not evidence of social equality or an automatic interpretation of A Thousand Plateaus.
